title: Saputara - The Serene Hill Station of Gujarat
content:
Saputara- Best Hill Station in Gujarat

Nestled in the Sahyadri range of the Western Ghats, Saputara is Gujarat’s only hill station and a perfect retreat for nature lovers. Located in the Dang district near the Maharashtra border, Saputara offers lush green landscapes, cool weather, waterfalls, and tribal heritage - making it an ideal year-round getaway for peace seekers and adventure enthusiasts alike.

History of Saputara

The name “Saputara” literally means “Abode of Serpents.” According to local beliefs, the hill is home to serpent gods worshipped by the tribal communities. Over the years, it has become a popular tourist destination developed by the Gujarat Tourism Department, attracting travelers looking for scenic beauty and tranquility.

Top Places to Visit in Saputara

1. Saputara Lake: The heart of the hill station, this beautiful lake surrounded by hills is perfect for boating and evening walks. You can enjoy paddle boating, horse rides, and local snacks near the lakeside.

2. Sunset Point: Offering mesmerizing views of the setting sun over the Sahyadri hills, this is one of the most visited spots in Saputara. The breathtaking panoramic view makes it ideal for photography lovers.

3. Sunrise Point (Valley View Point): Early risers can enjoy the golden sunrise illuminating the lush green valleys. It’s a great place for morning treks and peaceful meditation.

4. Saputara Tribal Museum: A must-visit to explore the Dang tribe’s rich culture, artifacts, traditional clothing, jewelry, and musical instruments.

5. Gira Waterfalls: Located about 50 km from Saputara, Gira Falls is one of the most spectacular waterfalls in Gujarat, especially during the monsoon season.

6. Step Garden and Rose Garden: Beautifully maintained gardens ideal for nature walks and relaxation, showcasing colorful flowers and well-laid pathways.

7. Ropeway Ride: One of Saputara’s top attractions - the ropeway offers a thrilling aerial view of the entire hill station, especially during sunrise and sunset.

8. Echo Point: Known for its natural echo phenomenon, this scenic spot is a fun place to visit with family and friends.

9. Artist Village: A cultural hub where you can watch local artisans create beautiful bamboo crafts, tribal paintings, and traditional artworks - perfect for buying souvenirs.

10. Vansda National Park: About 50 km from Saputara, this wildlife sanctuary is home to leopards, tigers, and numerous bird species.

Adventure Activities

Saputara is also great for trekking, paragliding, boating, and camping. Monsoon treks through misty hills are especially popular among adventure lovers.

Best Time to Visit

The best time to visit Saputara is from September to February, when the climate is cool and pleasant. The monsoon season (June-August) also offers magical views with fog-covered hills and flowing waterfalls.

How to Reach

  • By Air: The nearest airport is Surat (156 km away).
  • By Train: Waghai Railway Station is the closest, around 50 km from Saputara.
  • By Road: Well-connected by road to Surat, Nashik, and Vadodara.

Nearby Attractions

  • Waghai Botanical Garden (50 km) - A vast garden with rare plants and medicinal herbs.
  • Gira Waterfall (50 km) - A scenic waterfall near Waghai.
  • Unnai Hot Springs (60 km) - Natural hot water springs believed to have healing properties.
excerpt: Saputara, Gujarat’s only hill station, offers breathtaking landscapes, cool weather, and a touch of tribal culture. From lakes and waterfalls to gardens and ropeway rides, it’s a nature lover’s paradise. Perfect for a peaceful and scenic getaway all year round.
